title: RIP Windows: Linux GPU Gaming Benchmarks on Bazzite
summary: Gamers Nexus benchmarks GPU gaming performance on Linux using the Bazzite OS, an exploratory first step toward establishing a Linux testing methodology. It compares results against Windows and notes where Linux still falls short.
why: HN points to it as credible, methodical benchmark data in Linux-versus-Windows gaming discussions.

quote.text: Gamer's Nexus (a reputable source with good methodology) has some numbers here
